questions.q: What is the sequence of stages involved in the budding process of hydra?
options: Bud maturation $\rightarrow$ Bud initiation $\rightarrow$ Bud detachment $\rightarrow$ New individual
Bud initiation $\rightarrow$ Bud maturation $\rightarrow$ Bud detachment $\rightarrow$ New individual
New individual $\rightarrow$ Bud maturation $\rightarrow$ Bud detachment $\rightarrow$ Bud initiation
Bud initiation $\rightarrow$ Bud detachment $\rightarrow$ Bud maturation $\rightarrow$ New individual
questions.explain: In Hydra, reproduction by budding begins with bud initiation as an outgrowth, followed by bud maturation, its detachment from the parent body, and finally developing into a completely independent new individual.
questions.subject: General Science

questions.q: How many daughter cells are formed during binary fission?
questions.explain: Binary fission is an asexual reproduction method where a single parent cell divides into two equal and identical daughter cells.
questions.subject: General Science

questions.q: A student cuts the style of a flower before pollination occurs. What will be its effect?
options: The pollen tube will grow very quickly.
questions.explain: The style connects the stigma to the ovary. If the style is cut, pollen tubes cannot travel down to the ovary after pollination, preventing the male gamete from reaching the ovule, meaning fertilization will not occur.
